mapper.select: SELECT CAR_ID AS carId, CAR_NO AS carNo, MAKER_CODE AS makerCode, MODEL_GROUP_CODE AS modelGroupCode, MODEL_CODE AS modelCode, TRIM_CODE AS trimCode, GRADE_CODE AS gradeCode, MAKER_NAME AS makerName, MODEL_GROUP_NAME AS modelGroupName, MODEL_NAME AS modelName, TRIM_NAME AS trimName, YEAR AS year, MILEAGE AS mileage, COLOR AS color, transmission AS transmission, FUEL AS fuel, region AS region, displacement AS displacement, BODY_TYPE AS bodyType, adv_status AS advStatus, last_seen_date AS lastSeenDate, CREATED_AT AS createdAt, UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt FROM car_master WHERE CAR_ID = #{carId}

SELECT CAR_ID AS carId, CAR_NO AS carNo, MAKER_CODE AS makerCode, MODEL_GROUP_CODE AS modelGroupCode, MODEL_CODE AS modelCode, TRIM_CODE AS trimCode, GRADE_CODE AS gradeCode, MAKER_NAME AS makerName, MODEL_GROUP_NAME AS modelGroupName, MODEL_NAME AS modelName, TRIM_NAME AS trimName, YEAR AS year, MILEAGE AS mileage, COLOR AS color, transmission AS transmission, FUEL AS fuel, region AS region, displacement AS displacement, BODY_TYPE AS bodyType, adv_status AS advStatus, last_seen_date AS lastSeenDate, CREATED_AT AS createdAt, UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt FROM car_master
ORDER BY UPDATED_AT DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
